methods.B1: Deterministic structured score over the complete eligible set

relevance_scale.0: hard violation or insufficient hard evidence
relevance_scale.3: strong preference fit based on evidence

judgment_pool: canonical deduplicated union of B1/P top5, blinded and randomized
paired_population: same fully judged, metric-defined profile IDs for both methods; disclose all exclusions
freeze_order: G4 acknowledgement -> input/code/config hashes -> method outputs -> blind human annotation -> label hash -> metrics
api_budget_policy: operator declaration, not an automatic monetary spend cap
